after3_start.name: {name}
after3_start.text: *After school. My feet stop at the hallway junction. Signs for the student council room, the annex, and the gym point in different directions.*

after3_route_check.name: {name}
after3_route_check.text: *I check my phone. Who should I find first to talk about the weekend?*

after3_auto_dain.name: {name}
after3_auto_dain.text: *I think of Dain and head to the gym.*

after3_auto_yuna.name: {name}
after3_auto_yuna.text: *I think of Yuna and head to the library annex.*

after3_auto_seo.name: {name}
after3_auto_seo.text: *I think of Seoyeon and head to the student council room.*

after3_multi_choice.name: {name}
after3_multi_choice.text: *I can’t leave those weekend plans unresolved. Who should I speak to first?*
choices: Go to Seoyeon
Go to Yuna
Go to Dain
Think a little more

after3_choice.name: {name}
choices: To the student council room
To the library
To the gym
Just go home today

after3_reject_for_seo_1.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_seo_1.text: *When I run into Dain in the hall, she doesn't wave first. She only scuffs the floor with the toe of her sneaker.*

after3_reject_for_seo_2.name: Dain
after3_reject_for_seo_2.text: You're not coming to the gym today, are you?

after3_reject_for_seo_3.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_seo_3.text: *At the library, only a note remains in Yuna’s place: “Heading home first today.” I haven’t managed to discuss our plans.*

after3_reject_for_seo_4.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_seo_4.text: *I step into the hall. Dain had gone quiet, and Yuna’s seat was empty. I crumple the note in my hand along its folds.*

after3_seo_1.name: {name}
after3_seo_1.text: *I open the student council room door. Seoyeon is slumped over her desk, and her clipboard lies on the floor.*

after3_seo_3.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_3.text: *She lifts her head at the sound of someone entering. Her eyes look tired. Her makeup is slightly smudged.*

after3_seo_4.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_4.text: *Seoyeon uses the toe of her shoe to push the fallen clipboard beneath the desk.*

after3_seo_5_b.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_5_b.text: *Seoyeon combs her fingers through her hair.* Did you see?

after3_seo_6.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_6.text: *Seoyeon clears her throat once.* It's nothing. Forget it.

after3_seo_7.name: {name}
after3_seo_7.text: Forget what? I didn't see anything.

after3_seo_7_b.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_7_b.text: *Seoyeon covers the smeared makeup with the back of her hand.* I didn't want you to see this.

after3_seo_8.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_8.text: This side of me. Keep it a secret.

after3_seo_9.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_9.text: *Seoyeon retrieves the clipboard from under the desk and places it on her knees, lips pressed shut.*

after3_seo_choice.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_choice.text: Let what you saw today end here. For now, just treat me like you usually do.
choices: Everyone has days like this. Don't take it so hard.
Just now? I didn't see anything. I dropped my pen and came in to pick it up.
I’ll understand even the weak side of you.
From now on, I’ll stay beside you and take care of everything.

after3_seo_pity_trap_1.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_pity_trap_1.text: *Seoyeon rubs hard at the makeup smear with the back of her hand.*

after3_seo_pity_trap_4.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_pity_trap_4.text: *She wipes at the smudged makeup with the back of her hand, passing once beneath her eye and once across her mouth.*

after3_seo_pity_trap_5.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_pity_trap_5.text: Please don’t brush it off like that. I can’t just feel better right now.

after3_seo_pity_trap_6.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_pity_trap_6.text: *Seoyeon adjusts her glasses. A black smear remains on the back of her hand.*

after3_seo_pity_trap_7.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_pity_trap_7.text: Could you leave? I have work.

after3_seo_pity_trap_10.name: {name}
after3_seo_pity_trap_10.text: *I close the student council room door behind me. The hallway is empty. From inside comes the single sound of a clipboard being set on a desk.*

after3_seo_correct_1.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_correct_1.text: *The edge of the clipboard bends in her grip. Seoyeon waits for what I'll say next.*

after3_seo_correct_2.name: {name}
after3_seo_correct_2.text: *I bend down and feel beneath the desk, pretending to look for a pen. I take my time and keep my eyes off Seoyeon.*

after3_seo_correct_3.name: {name}
after3_seo_correct_3.text: Oh, here it is. Pens really go missing a lot in the student council room, huh?

after3_seo_correct_4.name: {name}
after3_seo_correct_4.text: *When I stand, a black streak marks the back of the hand Seoyeon used to wipe her makeup.*

after3_seo_correct_5.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_correct_5.text: The disappearing pens are a real mystery. Thirty vanish every year.

after3_seo_correct_6.name: {name}
after3_seo_correct_6.text: The president can't even catch the culprit?

after3_seo_correct_7.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_correct_7.text: *A short snort escapes her.* If I caught them, the students would start fearing the council.

after3_seo_correct_8.name: {name}
after3_seo_correct_8.text: *I keep talking about pens while Seoyeon adjusts her glasses, waiting for her to meet my eyes.*

after3_seo_correct_11.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_correct_11.text: Next time you lose a pen, come here first.

after3_seo_correct_12.name: {name}
after3_seo_correct_12.text: *Seoyeon folds next week's student council schedule and slides it toward me.*

after3_seo_freetalk.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_freetalk.text: *Seoyeon sets down her clipboard and pulls out the chair beside her.* Stay a little longer. If you’re not in a hurry.
after3_seo_freetalk.context: On the third afternoon, they are sitting together in the student council room. Instead of questioning Seoyeon about her tears, the player pretended to retrieve a pen and joked as usual. She offered next week’s schedule in gratitude. This scene deepened trust. Refer to separate appointment conflicts only if established by flags or memories.
after3_seo_freetalk.personality: Seoyeon is relieved that her dignity was respected. Her dry, brief humor returns and she makes room for the player. She does not immediately reveal every reason she was crying.

after3_reject_for_yuna_1.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_yuna_1.text: *Seoyeon is organizing her clipboard in the hallway. Her hands turn the pages faster than usual.*

after3_reject_for_yuna_2.name: Seoyeon
after3_reject_for_yuna_2.text: I still have council work. Go on ahead today.

after3_reject_for_yuna_walk_gym.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_yuna_walk_gym.text: *I turn toward the hall leading to the gym.*

after3_reject_for_yuna_3.name: Dain
after3_reject_for_yuna_3.text: *She is hitting balls alone in the gym.*

after3_reject_for_yuna_3_react.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_yuna_3_react.text: *She raises only one hand in greeting and turns her face away. The corner of the book in her grip presses into her palm.*

after3_reject_for_yuna_4.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_yuna_4.text: *I only talked about work with Seoyeon, and barely said hello to Dain. I still haven’t said what I meant to.*

after3_yuna_1.name: {name}
after3_yuna_1.text: *I arrive outside Yuna's secret reading space in the library annex. The door is open.*

after3_yuna_2.name: {name}
after3_yuna_2.text: *Yuna isn't there. Instead, an open notebook lies on the sofa, its pages filled with handwriting. Yuna's name is written in small letters inside the cover.*

after3_yuna_4.name: {name}
after3_yuna_4.text: *First page. 'One day a transfer student came. He found the library and sat next to me without saying a word. — I didn't mind it.'*

after3_yuna_5_b.name: {name}
after3_yuna_5_b.text: *Beneath the first sentence, “classroom window” is underlined.*

after3_yuna_7.name: {name}
after3_yuna_7.text: *Yuna's voice comes from behind me. Holding two drinks, she stops in the doorway and looks from the open notebook to me.*

after3_yuna_8b.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_8b.text: *Yuna comes over and snatches the notebook away.* I didn't say you could read it.

after3_yuna_9.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_9.text: *She hides the side of her face behind the notebook. Only the exposed tip of her ear is red.*

after3_yuna_choice.name: {name}
after3_yuna_choice.text: *I withdraw my hand from the notebook Yuna has taken back.*
choices: I'm sorry. But this is about me, isn't it?
I'm sorry. I only saw the open first page. I won't read any more. But this writer's prose is really good.
Don’t worry. I’ll keep this notebook safe for you.
From now on, show this kind of writing only to me.

after3_yuna_decode_trap_1.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_decode_trap_1.text: *Yuna presses the notebook to her chest and grips it hard enough to bend the cover.*

after3_yuna_decode_trap_3.name: {name}
after3_yuna_decode_trap_3.text: Not? But look at this part — 'reading by the classroom window—'

after3_yuna_decode_trap_5.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_decode_trap_5.text: *Yuna pushes the notebook deep into her bag and pulls the zipper all the way closed.*

after3_yuna_decode_trap_6.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_decode_trap_6.text: People like you are why I can't write a single line.

after3_yuna_decode_trap_8.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_decode_trap_8.text: If I get caught even inside fiction — there's nowhere left to escape.

after3_yuna_decode_trap_9.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_decode_trap_9.text: *Yuna slings her bag over her shoulder and heads for the door. The zipper pull swings with each step.*

after3_yuna_decode_trap_10.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_decode_trap_10.text: I'm keeping this place locked from now on.

after3_yuna_decode_trap_11.name: {name}
after3_yuna_decode_trap_11.text: *Her footsteps fade down the corridor. Only the notebook’s impression remains on the sofa. My promise to stop reading came too late.*

after3_yuna_correct_1.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_correct_1.text: *Her fingers loosen around the notebook for about a second.*

after3_yuna_correct_3.name: {name}
after3_yuna_correct_3.text: Yeah. Whose is this? Was it published?

after3_yuna_correct_4.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_correct_4.text: I don't know. It probably wasn't published.

after3_yuna_correct_5.name: {name}
after3_yuna_correct_5.text: Shame. Something this good shouldn't stay buried.

after3_yuna_correct_6.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_correct_6.text: *Yuna places the notebook on the desk and smooths the crumpled corner of the cover with her palm.*

after3_yuna_correct_9.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_correct_9.text: Let's say the writer gave permission.

after3_yuna_correct_10.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_correct_10.text: *Yuna holds the notebook out with both hands, but doesn't extend her arms all the way.*

after3_yuna_correct_11.name: {name}
after3_yuna_correct_11.text: *Even after the notebook passes into my hands, Yuna doesn't take her eyes off the cover.*

after3_yuna_correct_12.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_correct_12.text: When you're done, write one line for the writer. Anonymously.

after3_yuna_freetalk.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_freetalk.text: *Yuna glances at the notebook in my hands and makes room on the sofa.* Don’t read it yet. Talk with me for a bit first.
after3_yuna_freetalk.context: Third afternoon in the annex reading room. The player apologized for seeing the first page without permission and promised not to read further. Yuna then willingly lent the notebook. The player holds it and has not read the rest. She asked for one anonymous line of feedback after reading. They talk face to face on the sofa.
after3_yuna_freetalk.personality: Yuna is self-conscious about trusting someone with her writing. When embarrassed, she may speak of the author as someone else, but she does not withdraw that trust without cause. She continues with brief questions and quiet humor.

after3_reject_for_dain_1.name: Seoyeon
after3_reject_for_dain_1.text: *She's smiling as she lines up the corners of the pages on her clipboard.*

after3_reject_for_dain_2.name: Seoyeon
after3_reject_for_dain_2.text: I have some things to do today. I'll head out first.

after3_reject_for_dain_3.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_dain_3.text: *There is no note in the library. Yuna's bag is gone too. Only a faint ring of condensation remains on the desk, like she was here just moments ago.*

after3_reject_for_dain_3b.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_dain_3b.text: *I leave the annex and head toward the gym.*

after3_dain_1.name: {name}
after3_dain_1.text: *Dain is stretching alone in the gym. After a light hop, she leans to one side when she lands on her right leg, then immediately smooths out her expression.*

after3_dain_4.name: Dain
after3_dain_4.text: I'm fine! I just twisted it a little.

after3_dain_6.name: Dain
after3_dain_6.text: *Only after she finishes speaking does Dain laugh loudly.*

after3_dain_choice.name: Dain
after3_dain_choice.text: *She sits on the bench. The hand rubbing her knee keeps circling the same spot.*
choices: I knew you were pushing it. Drop the tournament and rest today.
Then I'll stay here. Talk when you're ready.
I’ll decide for you so you don’t overdo it.
Don’t worry. I’ll keep an eye on you from now on.

after3_dain_pity_trap_1.name: Dain
after3_dain_pity_trap_1.text: *Dain looks up at me, her palm still pressed to her knee.*

after3_dain_pity_trap_3.name: Dain
after3_dain_pity_trap_3.text: Hey. I'm not pushing it. I just landed wrong.

after3_dain_pity_trap_4.name: {name}
after3_dain_pity_trap_4.text: *Dain picks up her bag and rises, putting weight on her right leg again.*

after3_dain_pity_trap_5.name: Dain
after3_dain_pity_trap_5.text: Don't look at me like that. Not you too.

after3_dain_pity_trap_7.name: Dain
after3_dain_pity_trap_7.text: With that look they give me in the nurse's office.

after3_dain_pity_trap_8.name: Dain
after3_dain_pity_trap_8.text: *She walks toward the gym door. She doesn't run like usual. The drag of her sneakers leaves a long echo.*

after3_dain_pity_trap_9.name: Dain
after3_dain_pity_trap_9.text: I didn’t want to hear that from you, too.

after3_dain_pity_trap_10.name: {name}
after3_dain_pity_trap_10.text: *The gym door closes quietly. Dain’s wrist support lies on the floor where she left it.*

after3_dain_correct_1.name: Dain
after3_dain_correct_1.text: *Dain looks at me, still unable to lift the hand cupping her knee.*

after3_dain_correct_5.name: {name}
after3_dain_correct_5.text: Is that good weird or bad weird.

after3_dain_correct_6.name: Dain
after3_dain_correct_6.text: I don't know. But stay here for a minute. I don't really want to be alone right now.

after3_dain_correct_7.name: Dain
after3_dain_correct_7.text: *She makes room on the inside of the bench. With her toe, she rolls the volleyball out of the court.*

after3_dain_correct_10.name: Dain
after3_dain_correct_10.text: I don't usually talk about things like this. Where do I even start?

after3_dain_correct_11.name: Dain
after3_dain_correct_11.text: *Dain starts to extend her right leg, winces, and bends it again. Her palm never leaves her knee.*

after3_dain_dilemma_tell_2.name: {name}
after3_dain_dilemma_tell_2.text: Your knee. You've been rubbing it this whole time. This isn't from twisting it today, is it?

after3_dain_dilemma_tell_3.name: {name}
after3_dain_dilemma_tell_3.text: *Dain closes her mouth and only curls and uncurls the fingers on her knee.*

after3_dain_dilemma_tell_4.name: Dain
after3_dain_dilemma_tell_4.text: Why bring it up if you knew? You know the tournament is next week.

after3_dain_dilemma_tell_5.name: {name}
after3_dain_dilemma_tell_5.text: Your knee matters more than the tournament.

after3_dain_dilemma_tell_6.name: Dain
after3_dain_dilemma_tell_6.text: That's not your call to make.

after3_dain_dilemma_tell_7.name: Dain
after3_dain_dilemma_tell_7.text: *Dain bends to tie her shoe, then grabs her knee. She never reaches the laces.*

after3_dain_dilemma_tell_8.name: Dain
after3_dain_dilemma_tell_8.text: Please. Don't tell anyone about this.

after3_dain_dilemma_final.name: Dain
after3_dain_dilemma_final.text: *Dain doesn't wipe her wet eyes. None of her usual laughter follows her final words.*
choices: Sorry. But I'm telling.
Okay. You tell them yourself. But I'm going to the nurse's office with you.
I’ll explain it to the teacher. You just rest.
If you keep hesitating, it’d be better if I told them first.

after3_dain_tell_confirm_2.name: Dain
after3_dain_tell_confirm_2.text: *She grabs her bag and walks out. She doesn't look back. The gym door slams shut.*

after3_dain_tell_confirm_3.name: {name}
after3_dain_tell_confirm_3.text: *Dain's footsteps fade beyond the closed door. Alone in the empty gym, I feel the sweat cool on my palms.*

after3_dain_tell_retreat.name: Dain
after3_dain_tell_retreat.text: *Dain lets out a long breath and stops the ball rolling toward her with her toe.* ...You'll wait until I can say it myself?

after3_dain_choice1.name: {name}
after3_dain_choice1.text: *I sit beside her without pressing for an answer. Dain looks over while picking at her shoelace.*

after3_dain_choice1_3.name: {name}
after3_dain_choice1_3.text: You said you'd tell them when you were ready.

after3_dain_choice1_react.name: Dain
after3_dain_choice1_react.text: *Dain bites her lip, lets out a small laugh, and rubs her eyes with the back of her hand.*

after3_dain_choice1_react2.name: Dain
after3_dain_choice1_react2.text: Yeah. If you'd asked now, I would've said I was fine again.

after3_dain_choice1_react3.name: Dain
after3_dain_choice1_react3.text: Thanks. When I go to the nurse's office... stay with me.

after3_dain_freetalk.name: Dain
after3_dain_freetalk.text: *She adjusts her wrist guard; her mouth turns up half a beat late.* Today, I'll talk first.
after3_dain_freetalk.context: Third afternoon, on a gym bench. Dain admitted her right knee still hurts. The player agreed to wait for her to speak instead of deciding for her. She asked for company when she visits the infirmary. No examination or competition decision has happened yet. They are sitting and talking face to face.
after3_dain_freetalk.personality: Dain is an energetic and straightforward volleyball player. Humor and sincerity can both appear naturally as she expresses what she feels and what she wants to know about the relationship.

after3_dain_end.name: Dain
after3_dain_end.text: *Dain's fist touches my shoulder, but it doesn't push me back like yesterday.*

after3_dain_end_first.name: Dain
after3_dain_end_first.text: *Dain punches my shoulder, then immediately puts her hand in her pocket.*

after3_confront_1.name: {name}
after3_confront_1.text: *When I leave our meeting place, Seoyeon is waiting in the hall with her arms crossed. Her fingers tap a steady rhythm against her upper arm.*

after3_confront_3.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_3.text: *Seoyeon leads me to an empty landing at the end of the hall.*

after3_confront_5.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_5.text: When you smiled at the other girls the same way, I felt like I'd been the only one reading into it.

after3_confront_5_b.name: Dain
after3_confront_5_b.text: Me too. I didn't like it.

after3_confront_5_c.name: Dain
after3_confront_5_c.text: *The toe of Dain's sneaker briefly scrapes the hallway floor.*

after3_confront_6.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_6.text: About lunch. Why did you make several plans without explaining any of it?

after3_confront_choice.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_choice.text: *Seoyeon lowers the clipboard to her side and takes one step away, waiting for an answer.*
choices: Admit it honestly
The time slots are different, so I thought it would be fine
You’re the only one I’m serious about

after3_confront_admit_b.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_admit_b.text: *Seoyeon looks down at the handle of her lunch bag.*

after3_confront_admit_2.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_admit_2.text: More than an apology, I want to hear what you’ll do about those plans now.

after3_confront_admit_3.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_admit_3.text: *When Seoyeon picks up the lunch bag, the handle twists in her hand.*

after3_confront_admit_4.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_admit_4.text: You didn't want to hear us say no, so you left the decision to us. That isn't honesty.

after3_confront_admit_4_b.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_admit_4_b.text: *Seoyeon turns away and stops in front of a classroom door handle.*

after3_confront_admit_5.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_admit_5.text: I won't be leaving the rooftop open today.

after3_confront_excuse.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_excuse.text: You don't see how that's the problem?

after3_confront_excuse_2.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_excuse_2.text: It's not about how many people you made plans with. It's about what that promise meant to me.

after3_confront_excuse_2_b.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_excuse_2_b.text: *Seoyeon opens her mouth, closes it, and pulls the clipboard toward her chest.*

after3_confront_lie_b.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_lie_b.text: *The clipboard drops slightly in Seoyeon's hand. This time, she looks directly at {name}.*

after3_confront_lie.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_lie.text: Really? I can believe you, right?

after3_confront_lie_2.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_lie_2.text: *Without waiting for an answer, Seoyeon walks to the end of the hall. Her grip on the clipboard never loosens.*

after3_confront_end.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_end.text: *Seoyeon walks toward the far end of the empty hall. Beside her rigid back, all I can see is her clenched fist.*

after3_group_teacher_companion.name: Homeroom Teacher and companion
after3_group_teacher_companion.text: *Classes are over. In a classroom left open for the event, the teacher spreads out the event draft while the companion lays out different materials across from her. After checking the clock, the teacher points to each task in turn.* "There is barely time to finish one of these. Whose work will you help with first?"
after3_group_teacher_companion.context: After school, the protagonist is reviewing a draft for a public school literature event with the homeroom teacher in an open classroom when the other character with the highest affinity joins them with separate event materials or a request. There is only enough time to finish one task, so the teacher asks whose work the protagonist will help with first.
after3_group_teacher_companion.personality: The teacher keeps professional distance while guiding the discussion with dry humor and precise notes. Let the companion contribute real opinions through their own voice and interests. Do not turn this into a private teacher-student relationship or a closed-door meeting.
after3_group_teacher_companion.groupChoiceState: the protagonist must say whether to help with the teacher's literature-event draft or the companion's request first
after3_group_teacher_companion.groupAftermathCause: whom the protagonist chose to help first in the open classroom, and why

after3_group_nurse_companion.name: School Nurse and companion
after3_group_nurse_companion.text: *A health-check sheet lies beside a box of athletic-club supplies. The nurse points to an empty line while the companion holds up one of the supplies running low.* "Both need checking today, but we have to start with one. Whose task should we handle first?"
after3_group_nurse_companion.context: After school in the nurse's office, the protagonist is helping the school nurse organize athletic health checks when the other character with the highest affinity arrives with an urgent supply problem. There is only time to begin with one task, so the nurse asks whose work the protagonist will handle first.
after3_group_nurse_companion.personality: The nurse may ease tension with a light joke, but she never uses care or treatment as an excuse for affection. The companion reacts to the health check or supplies according to their own personality and current condition. Do not inflate routine work into an accident or a secret meeting.
after3_group_nurse_companion.groupChoiceState: the protagonist must say whether to handle the nurse's health check or the companion's supply problem first
after3_group_nurse_companion.groupAftermathCause: whom the protagonist chose to help first in the nurse's office, and why

after3_group_return.name: {name}
after3_group_return.text: *After the conversation, I step back into the hallway.*

after3_final.name: {name}
after3_final.text: *The afternoon ends. One by one, the hallway lights switch off.*

minsu_d3_1.name: {name}
minsu_d3_1.text: *Walking home. Minsu is standing by the school gate.*

minsu_d3_3.name: Minsu
minsu_d3_3.text: At lunch. And Seoyeon's face just now.

minsu_d3_5.name: Minsu
minsu_d3_5.text: It's rough watching from the side. They're all good people. I don't think you're doing this on purpose, but you keep putting off saying no.

minsu_d3_5b.name: Minsu
minsu_d3_5b.text: *Minsu folds the straw wrapper in his hand.*

minsu_d3_6b.name: Minsu
minsu_d3_6b.text: I won't ask what happened at your old school. But I'll say one thing.

minsu_d3_7.name: Minsu
minsu_d3_7.text: Saying no is consideration too. If it isn't going to work, drawing the line now is better than leaving room for hope.

minsu_d3_8.name: {name}
minsu_d3_8.text: *At my old school, I put off speaking, too. I saw the graffiti on Sojeong’s desk and never told a teacher. This time I can’t call silence kindness.*

minsu_d3_9.name: Minsu
minsu_d3_9.text: *Minsu falls quiet and puts the folded straw wrapper in his pocket.*

minsu_d3_10.name: Minsu
minsu_d3_10.text: See you at school tomorrow. Think about it seriously.

haeun_warn_1.name: {name}
haeun_warn_1.text: *Someone is waiting at the end of the hallway toward the gate.*

haeun_warn_1_b.name: Haeun
haeun_warn_1_b.text: *Haeun leans against the wall, fiddling with her student council bracelet.*

haeun_warn_2_b.name: {name}
haeun_warn_2_b.text: Haeun? What are you doing here?

haeun_warn_4.name: Haeun
haeun_warn_4.text: I saw her for a moment in the bathroom behind the student council room. She told me she was fine, but she didn't look fine.

haeun_warn_5.name: {name}
haeun_warn_5.text: *Haeun checks the empty hall, then lowers her voice further.*

haeun_warn_5b.name: Haeun
haeun_warn_5b.text: She told me not to talk to her, but she stayed at the sink for a long time.

haeun_warn_5c.name: {name}
haeun_warn_5c.text: *I look back toward the bathroom at the end of the hall.*

haeun_warn_6.name: Haeun
haeun_warn_6.text: If I follow her, she'll just tell me she's fine again. She might listen to you, {name}.

haeun_warn_6_b.name: Haeun
haeun_warn_6_b.text: *Haeun turns the student council bracelet toward the inside of her wrist.*

haeun_warn_7.name: Haeun
haeun_warn_7.text: I know I'm meddling. But just for today, please don't pretend you didn't notice.

haeun_warn_7_b.name: Haeun
haeun_warn_7_b.text: *Haeun presses her lips together and checks toward the faculty office while fingering the clasp of her bracelet.*

haeun_warn_7_c.name: Haeun
haeun_warn_7_c.text: If she wants to be alone, give her time. Could you check later that she got home safely?

haeun_freetalk.name: Haeun
haeun_freetalk.text: *Haeun does not turn away. She looks you straight in the eye.* "...I'm waiting for an answer. What are you going to do now?"
haeun_freetalk.context: Haeun has seen Seoyeon crying. She asks the player to respect Seoyeon’s wish for space and check later that she got home. They are still in the hallway, where Haeun wants to hear the player’s intentions; she is not asking them to return immediately or ignore a refusal.
haeun_freetalk.personality: Haeun remains polite but will not brush aside the fact that Seoyeon was hurt. She wants to hear what the protagonist will do now rather than an excuse. She may question or challenge his answer, but she does not decide Seoyeon's feelings for her or force the protagonist to perform an action. Do not turn the exchange romantic or sexual. Her affinity represents only personal trust and regard and affects no ending.

haeun_affinity_high_1.name: Haeun
haeun_affinity_high_1.text: *Haeun studies {name}'s face for a moment, then straightens the student council bracelet that had twisted around to the inside of her wrist.* ...I'll believe you.

haeun_affinity_high_2.name: Haeun
haeun_affinity_high_2.text: Even if Seoyeon says she's fine, ask her one more time today. She says that when she isn't fine, too.

haeun_affinity_neutral_1.name: Haeun
haeun_affinity_neutral_1.text: *Haeun keeps her fingers on the bracelet clasp and slowly nods.* I don't completely believe you yet.

haeun_affinity_neutral_2.name: Haeun
haeun_affinity_neutral_2.text: Just keep the promise you made. And check later that she got home safely.

haeun_affinity_low_1.name: Haeun
haeun_affinity_low_1.text: *Haeun grips the bracelet and takes half a step back.* I don't think I can trust you with Seoyeon right now, {name}.

haeun_affinity_low_2.name: Haeun
haeun_affinity_low_2.text: I'll tell the faculty adviser, too. If you do go see Seoyeon, don't say anything that hurts her even more.

haeun_warn_8.name: {name}
haeun_warn_8.text: *After Haeun leaves, I knock on the student council room door. No one answers, but a chair scrapes inside.*

haeun_warn_8b.name: {name}
haeun_warn_8b.text: *I walk out to the front of the school.*

after3_walk_home.name: {name}
after3_walk_home.text: *I can’t find any more words today. I put my phone away and walk toward the gate.*

after3_rival_seo_high.name: Seoyeon
after3_rival_seo_high.text: *Seoyeon stops at the junction, checks which way I'm headed, and adjusts her grip on her bag strap.* So you're going somewhere else.

after3_rival_seo_mid.name: Seoyeon
after3_rival_seo_mid.text: Okay. I'll finish up what is left.

after3_rival_dain_high.name: Dain
after3_rival_dain_high.text: *Dain swallows her question and looks at the sign for the gym.* You're going somewhere else? Got it.

after3_rival_dain_mid.name: Dain
after3_rival_dain_mid.text: Okay. I'll head to the gym first.

after3_rival_yuna_high.name: Yuna
after3_rival_yuna_high.text: *Yuna closes the book she was about to open.* So you're going somewhere else. Okay.

after3_rival_yuna_mid.name: Yuna
after3_rival_yuna_mid.text: Okay. I'll be in the library.

after3_seo_partial_1.name: {name}
after3_seo_partial_1.text: *When I open the student council room door, Seoyeon is picking her clipboard up from the floor. She wipes beneath one eye and sets a chair straight.*

after3_seo_partial_2.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_partial_2.text: I'll finish this alone today. Just don't avoid me tomorrow.

after3_seo_low_1.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_low_1.text: *Seoyeon stands in the hall with the door only half open.* I want to be alone right now. See you tomorrow.

after3_yuna_partial_1.name: {name}
after3_yuna_partial_1.text: *The annex door is open, but Yuna does not open her book. She glances at the chair across from her, then pushes it beneath the desk.*

after3_yuna_partial_2.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_partial_2.text: Let's stop here today. Next time, I'll ask you first.

after3_yuna_low_1.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_low_1.text: *Yuna shoulders her bag at the annex door.* I want to be alone today. I'm leaving first.

after3_dain_partial_1.name: {name}
after3_dain_partial_1.text: *Inside the gym, Dain adjusts her knee brace. She starts to stand, then sits back down on the bench.*

after3_dain_partial_2.name: Dain
after3_dain_partial_2.text: It'll be fine after some rest. Go on ahead. See you tomorrow.

after3_dain_low_1.name: Dain
after3_dain_low_1.text: *Dain holds the gym door without stepping inside.* I'm practicing alone today. See you at school.

minsu_d3_4_established.name: Minsu
minsu_d3_4_established.text: It bothered me yesterday, too. One person at lunch, someone else after school. After what happened today, I don’t think you can just let it slide.

minsu_d3_4_first.name: Minsu
minsu_d3_4_first.text: I didn’t say anything yesterday, but I can’t just ignore what happened at lunch.

after3_seo_overcare_react.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_overcare_react.text: Understand and take care of everything? I only asked you to treat me normally.

after3_yuna_control_react.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_control_react.text: It’s my notebook. I decide who reads it or keeps it.

after3_dain_control_react.name: Dain
after3_dain_control_react.text: Don’t decide for me. I didn’t ask you to keep watch, either.
